NASB.1: Now when Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, 'I am God Almighty; Walk before Me, and be blameless.
NASB.2: 'I will establish My covenant between Me and you, And I will multiply you exceedingly.'
NASB.3: Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying,
NASB.4: 'As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, And you will be the father of a multitude of nations.
NASB.5: 'No longer shall your name be called Abram, But your name shall be Abraham; For I will make you the father of a multitude of nations.
NASB.6: 'I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you, and kings will come forth from you.
NASB.7: 'I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your descendants after you.
NASB.8: 'I will give to you and to your descendants after you, the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.'
NASB.9: God said further to Abraham, 'Now as for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.
NASB.10: 'This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and your descendants after you: every male among you shall be circumcised.
NASB.11: 'And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be the sign of the covenant between Me and you.
NASB.12: 'And every male among you who is eight days old shall be circumcised throughout your generations, a [servant] who is born in the house or who is bought with money from any foreigner, who is not of your descendants.
NASB.13: 'A [servant] who is born in your house or who is bought with your money shall surely be circumcised; thus shall My covenant be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
NASB.14: 'But an uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.'
NASB.15: Then God said to Abraham, 'As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah [shall be] her name.
NASB.16: 'I will bless her, and indeed I will give you a son by her. Then I will bless her, and she shall be [a mother of] nations; kings of peoples will come from her.'
NASB.17: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, 'Will a child be born to a man one hundred years old? And will Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear [a child]?'
NASB.18: And Abraham said to God, 'Oh that Ishmael might live before You!'
NASB.19: But God said, 'No, but Sarah your wife will bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
NASB.20: 'As for Ishmael, I have heard you; behold, I will bless him, and will make him fruitful and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
NASB.21: 'But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this season next year.'
NASB.22: When He finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
NASB.23: Then Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all [the servants] who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's household, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the very same day, as God had said to him.
NASB.24: Now Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
NASB.25: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
NASB.26: In the very same day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
NASB.27: All the men of his household, who were born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

ESV.1: When Abram was ninety-nine years old the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty;  walk before me, and be blameless,
ESV.2: that I may make my covenant between me and you, and may multiply you greatly.”
ESV.3: Then Abram fell on his face. And God said to him,
ESV.4: “Behold, my covenant is with you, and you shall be the father of a multitude of nations.
ESV.5: No longer shall your name be called Abram,  but your name shall be Abraham,  for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
ESV.6: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make you into nations, and kings shall come from you.
ESV.7: And I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your offspring after you.
ESV.8: And I will give to you and to your offspring after you the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession, and I will be their God.”
ESV.9: And God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
ESV.10: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
ESV.11: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and you.
ESV.12: He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised. Every male throughout your generations, whether born in your house or bought with your money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring,
ESV.13: both he who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money, shall surely be circumcised. So shall my covenant be in your flesh an everlasting covenant.
ESV.14: Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin shall be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”
ESV.15: And God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah  shall be her name.
ESV.16: I will bless her, and moreover, I will give  you a son by her. I will bless her, and she shall become nations; kings of peoples shall come from her.”
ESV.17: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed and said to himself, “Shall a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear a child?”
ESV.18: And Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
ESV.19: God said, “No, but Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac.  I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
ESV.20: As for Ishmael, I have heard you; behold, I have blessed him and will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.
ESV.21: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this time next year.”
ESV.22: When he had finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
ESV.23: Then Abraham took Ishmael his son and all those born in his house or bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house, and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very day, as God had said to him.
ESV.24: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
ESV.25: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
ESV.26: That very day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.
ESV.27: And all the men of his house, those born in the house and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

NKJV.23: So Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very same day, as God had said to him.

NLT.1: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am El-Shaddai — ‘God Almighty.’ Serve me faithfully and live a blameless life.
NLT.2: I will make a covenant with you, by which I will guarantee to give you countless descendants.”
NLT.3: At this, Abram fell face down on the ground. Then God said to him,
NLT.4: “This is my covenant with you: I will make you the father of a multitude of nations!
NLT.5: What’s more, I am changing your name. It will no longer be Abram. Instead, you will be called Abraham, for you will be the father of many nations.
NLT.6: I will make you extremely fruitful. Your descendants will become many nations, and kings will be among them!
NLT.7: “I will confirm my covenant with you and your descendants after you, from generation to generation. This is the everlasting covenant: I will always be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
NLT.8: And I will give the entire land of Canaan, where you now live as a foreigner, to you and your descendants. It will be their possession forever, and I will be their God.”
NLT.9: Then God said to Abraham, “Your responsibility is to obey the terms of the covenant. You and all your descendants have this continual responsibility.
NLT.10: This is the covenant that you and your descendants must keep: Each male among you must be circumcised.
NLT.11: You must cut off the flesh of your foreskin as a sign of the covenant between me and you.
NLT.12: From generation to generation, every male child must be circumcised on the eighth day after his birth. This applies not only to members of your family but also to the servants born in your household and the foreign-born servants whom you have purchased.
NLT.13: All must be circumcised. Your bodies will bear the mark of my everlasting covenant.
NLT.14: Any male who fails to be circumcised will be cut off from the covenant family for breaking the covenant.”
NLT.15: Then God said to Abraham, “Regarding Sarai, your wife — her name will no longer be Sarai. From now on her name will be Sarah.
NLT.16: And I will bless her and give you a son from her! Yes, I will bless her richly, and she will become the mother of many nations. Kings of nations will be among her descendants.”
NLT.17: Then Abraham bowed down to the ground, but he laughed to himself in disbelief. “How could I become a father at the age of 100?” he thought. “And how can Sarah have a baby when she is ninety years old?”
NLT.18: So Abraham said to God, “May Ishmael live under your special blessing!”
NLT.19: But God replied, “No — Sarah, your wife, will give birth to a son for you. You will name him Isaac, and I will confirm my covenant with him and his descendants as an everlasting covenant.
NLT.20: As for Ishmael, I will bless him also, just as you have asked. I will make him extremely fruitful and multiply his descendants. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
NLT.21: But my covenant will be confirmed with Isaac, who will be born to you and Sarah about this time next year.”
NLT.22: When God had finished speaking, he left Abraham.
NLT.23: On that very day Abraham took his son, Ishmael, and every male in his household, including those born there and those he had bought. Then he circumcised them, cutting off their foreskins, just as God had told him.
NLT.24: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
NLT.25: and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen.
NLT.26: Both Abraham and his son, Ishmael, were circumcised on that same day,
NLT.27: along with all the other men and boys of the household, whether they were born there or bought as servants. All were circumcised with him.

WEB.1: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
WEB.2: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
WEB.3: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
WEB.4: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
WEB.5: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
WEB.6: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
WEB.7: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring  after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring  after you.
WEB.8: I will give to you, and to your offspring  after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
WEB.9: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your offspring  after you throughout their generations.
WEB.10: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring  after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
WEB.11: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
WEB.12: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
WEB.13: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
WEB.14: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
WEB.15: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
WEB.16: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
WEB.17: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
WEB.18: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
WEB.19: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac.  I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring  after him.
WEB.20: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
WEB.21: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
WEB.22: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
WEB.23: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
WEB.24: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
WEB.25: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

CSB17.1: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him, saying, “I am God Almighty. <sup>ⓓ</sup> Live <sup>[1]</sup> in my presence and be blameless. <sup>ⓔ</sup>
CSB17.2: I will set up my covenant between me and you, and I will multiply you greatly.”
CSB17.3: Then Abram fell facedown and God spoke with him:
CSB17.4: “As for me, here is my covenant with you: You will become the father of many nations.
CSB17.5: Your name will no longer be Abram; <sup>[2]</sup> your name will be Abraham, <sup>[3]</sup> for I will make you the father of many nations. <sup>ⓕ</sup>
CSB17.6: I will make you extremely fruitful and will make nations and kings come from you.
CSB17.7: I will confirm my covenant that is between me and you and your future offspring throughout their generations. It is a permanent covenant <sup>ⓖ</sup> to be your God and the God of your offspring after you. <sup>ⓗ</sup>
CSB17.8: And to you and your future offspring <sup>ⓘ</sup> I will give the land where you are residing — all the land of Canaan — as a permanent possession, <sup>ⓙ</sup> and I will be their God.”
CSB17.9: God also said to Abraham, “As for you, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations are to keep my covenant.
CSB17.10: This is my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you, which you are to keep: Every one of your males must be circumcised.
CSB17.11: You must circumcise the flesh of your foreskin to serve as a sign of the covenant between me and you. <sup>[4]</sup> <sup>ⓚ</sup>
CSB17.12: Throughout your generations, every male among you is to be circumcised <sup>ⓛ</sup> at eight days old — every male born in your household or purchased from any foreigner and not your offspring.
CSB17.13: Whether born in your household or purchased, he must be circumcised. My covenant will be marked in your flesh as a permanent covenant.
CSB17.14: If any male is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that man will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”
CSB17.15: God said to Abraham, “As for your wife Sarai, do not call her Sarai, for Sarah <sup>[5]</sup> will be her name.
CSB17.16: I will bless her; indeed, I will give you a son by her. <sup>ⓜ</sup> I will bless her, and she will produce nations; kings of peoples will come from her.”
CSB17.17: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed <sup>ⓝ</sup> and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a hundred-year-old man? Can Sarah, a ninety-year-old woman, give birth?”
CSB17.18: So Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael were acceptable <sup>[6]</sup> to you!”
CSB17.19: But God said, “No. Your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will name him Isaac. <sup>[7]</sup> I will confirm my covenant with him as a permanent covenant for his future offspring.
CSB17.20: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. I will certainly bless him; I will make him fruitful and will multiply him greatly. He will father twelve tribal leaders, <sup>ⓐ</sup> and I will make him into a great nation.
CSB17.21: But I will confirm my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.” <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.22: When he finished talking with him, God withdrew <sup>[8]</sup> from Abraham. <sup>ⓒ</sup>
CSB17.23: So Abraham took his son Ishmael and those born in his household or purchased — every male among the members of Abraham’s household — and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskin on that very day, just as God had said to him.
CSB17.24: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when the flesh of his foreskin was circumcised,
CSB17.25: and his son Ishmael was thirteen years old when the flesh of his foreskin was circumcised.
CSB17.26: On that same day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.
CSB17.27: And all the men of his household — whether born in his household or purchased from a foreigner — were circumcised with him.

AMP.1:
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said,
"I am God Almighty;
Walk [habitually] before Me [with integrity, knowing that you are always in My presence], and be blameless and complete [in obedience to Me].
AMP.2:
"I will establish My covenant (everlasting promise) between Me and you,
And I will multiply you exceedingly [through your descendants]."
AMP.3: Then Abram fell on his face [in worship], and God spoke with him, saying,
AMP.4:
"As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you,
And [as a result] you shall be the father of many nations.
AMP.5:
"No longer shall your name be Abram (exalted father),
But your name shall be Abraham (father of a multitude);
For I will make you the father of many nations.
AMP.6: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
AMP.7: I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your descendants after you.
AMP.8: I will give to you and to your descendants after you the land in which you are a stranger [moving from place to place], all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession [of property]; and I will be their God."
AMP.9: Further, God said to Abraham, "As for you [your part of the agreement], you shall keep and faithfully obey [the terms of] My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.
AMP.10: This is [the sign of] My covenant, which you shall keep and faithfully obey, between Me and you and your descendants after you: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
AMP.11: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be the sign (symbol, memorial) of the covenant between Me and you.
AMP.12: Every male among you who is eight days old shall be circumcised throughout your generations, [including] a servant whether born in the house or one who is purchased with [your] money from any foreigner, who is not of your descendants.
AMP.13: A servant who is born in your house or one who is purchased with your money must be circumcised; and [the sign of] My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
AMP.14: And the male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant."
AMP.15: Then God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai (my princess), but her name will be Sarah ( Princess).
AMP.16: I will bless her, and indeed I will also give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."
AMP.17: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Shall a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear a child?"
AMP.18: And Abraham said to God, "Oh, that Ishmael [my firstborn] might live before You!"
AMP.19: But God said, "No, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son indeed, and you shall name him Isaac (laughter); and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant and with his descendants after him.
AMP.20: As for Ishmael, I have heard and listened to you; behold, I will bless him, and will make him fruitful and will greatly multiply him [through his descendants]. He will be the father of twelve princes (chieftains, sheiks), and I will make him a great nation.
AMP.21: But My covenant [My promise, My solemn pledge], I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year."
AMP.22: And God finished speaking with him and went up from Abraham.
AMP.23: Then Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all the servants who were born in his house and all who were purchased with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's household, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin the very same day, as God had said to him.
AMP.24: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised.
AMP.25: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised.
AMP.26: On the very same day Abraham was circumcised, as well as Ishmael his son.
AMP.27: All the men [servants] of his household, both those born in the house and those purchased with money from a foreigner, were circumcised along with him [as the sign of God's covenant with Abraham].
